ci(policy): harden policy shell helpers (#36)

## Summary

Bundles two approved follow-ups from the evidence-tag-lint strict-graduation arc (#33 / #34 / #35) into a single `ci(policy):` hardening PR. Both are script-scoped, non-breaking, and independent of the in-flight audit's docs/ planning-corpus surface.

**Commit 1 — position-anchor the tier regex**. Tightens the tier-presence filter so `(T<n>)` must sit immediately after the EV-ID.

**Commit 2 — tree-wide pipefail sweep**. Adds `set -o pipefail` across the four policy shell scripts.
